# ULTRON 1.0.0 — Apple Silicon Preview

This is the first downloadable build for **Macs with Apple Silicon**: M1, M2,
M3 and later.

## Included

- local Electron desktop application;
- local FastAPI core bundled inside the app;
- local account profiles, memory confirmation and security boundaries;
- Ollama, Obsidian, Mail and 3D-printer integrations configured on demand;
- SHA-256 checksum for the ZIP.

## Install

1. Download ULTRON-ai-1.0.0-macos-arm64.zip.
2. Compare its SHA-256 with the accompanying .sha256 file.
3. Unzip it and move **ULTRON ai.app** to Applications.
4. Open the app.

## Preview status

The package has passed source, security, archive integrity and Apple Silicon
build checks. It is an **ad-hoc signed preview** while the maintainer prepares
a Developer ID certificate and Apple notarization.

macOS may ask you to explicitly approve the first launch. A notarized official
build will replace this preview after Apple credentials are configured.

## Platforms

Apple Silicon is the first supported download. Intel Mac, Windows and Linux are
planned in that order and are not included in this release.
